digest.component_or_area: write lock acquisition and retry mechanism
propositions: A store write whose lock acquire times out within a single budget is permanently discarded with no retry mechanism, resulting in silent data loss
The budget is computed as total_wait = timeout * attempts on a single deadline, where attempts is a pure multiplier rather than a retry loop
Both fcntl and mkdir lock legs poll non-blocking with jitter and no fairness, making timeouts reachable when holder duration exceeds the budget even under normal load

Bounded retry-with-backoff inside acquire() converts terminal loss into latency by re-attempting acquisition up to N passes, with exponential backoff between passes and no replay risk since retry happens before write body execution
Five call sites opt in to retries via retries parameter and REBAR_LOCK_RETRIES environment variable (default 2, clamped [0,10]), while all other callers stay fail-fast with retries=0 default
Retry safety is guaranteed because LockTimeout is raised by acquire() before anything is staged or committed, preventing double-write that would require retrying above the lock layer
